user.title: Wallbox
user.description: Select existing wallbox state entities. No commands are sent.

vehicle.title: Add a vehicle
vehicle.description: Enter a name and select the vehicle sensors. Configure the target SOC here; no in-car target sensor is required.

more.title: More vehicles
more.description: Would you like to add another vehicle?

energy_menu.title: Power measurements — choose one method
energy_menu.description: Choose ONE of three alternatives, not a combination: A direct home-only measurements; B site total (including EV) minus EV charging (wallbox DPM or another meter); C no power sensors.

house_sources.title: Method A — Direct sensors (e.g. Shelly)
house_sources.description: Choose one or more non-overlapping sensors covering the house WITHOUT EV charging. An independent EV power sensor is optional.

total_sources.title: Method B — Total minus EV (DPM or meter)
total_sources.description: Home = site total − EV. The total sensor (wallbox DPM or another meter) MUST include EV charging; verify coverage before use. EV power can come from ESPHome, Shelly or another sensor.

error.invalid_vehicle: Check vehicle details: duplicate name, duplicate SOC entity or invalid values.
error.invalid_energy: Check that the required sensors are present, distinct and non-duplicated.

init.title: Configuration
init.description: Choose what to edit, and save only when finished.

confirm_remove.title: Confirm removal
confirm_remove.description: Delete the selected profile? No device commands are sent.

finish.title: Save changes
finish.description: At least one vehicle is required.

planning.title: Planning — simulation only
planning.description: Set the site's continuous available power for HOUSE + EV. Do not include temporary overloads. Specify usual weekday and weekend departure times, editable later. No wallbox commands are sent.
